name: Marvin
author: Cloud First Consulting
description: Say "Hey Marvin" and it opens apps, switches workspaces, tells you which key does what from your live bindings, or works out why Bluetooth will not connect. Wake word, transcription and speech run locally; only the text of an unrecognised request goes to the coding agent Omarchy is already set to. Audio never leaves the machine.

barWidget.description: One bar icon showing whether the wake word is listening and on which microphone, and a panel to stop it, start it, or move it to another input.
